sn28.10:3.2: When asked ‘Well then, do you eat facing upwards’, you answer ‘No, sister, I do not eat facing upwards’.
sn28.10:3.3: When asked ‘Well then, do you eat facing the cardinal directions’, you answer ‘No, sister, I do not eat facing the cardinal directions’.
sn28.10:3.4: When asked ‘Well then, do you eat facing the intermediate directions’, you answer ‘No, sister, I do not eat facing the intermediate directions’.
